d:
A group of friends who met in 2014 now live on three continents. Every time they plan a trip together, the same thing happens. Five hundred messages in a group chat nobody can read back. A spreadsheet that made sense to one person. Vouchers scattered across four conversations and two inboxes. Somebody at home refreshing a flight tracker at 2am.

Tripmojo is what we built so that stopped happening to us.

One place for the whole trip. Every booking, document and plan in one view that everyone travelling can edit and everyone at home can follow. AI does the heavy lifting, reading confirmations, building the day by day, watching the flights. People make the calls that actually decide whether a trip was any good, because a machine does not know that the early train is a mistake or that day four needs a slow morning.

Built by people who travel, for people who travel, and increasingly for the travel professionals who plan for everyone else.

name: Voltaire Power Systems LLP
d:
Your production line can't afford voltage problems. Neither can you.
We're Voltaire Power Systems — a factory-direct manufacturer of industrial servo voltage stabilizers and electrical distribution equipment, built on over 30 years of manufacturing experience in industrial power solutions.
We don't resell. We don't assemble other people's products. We design, build, and test everything in-house at our facility in Delhi NCR — the same way we've been doing it for three decades.
What we manufacture:

Servo voltage stabilizers (50 kVA to 500 kVA+)
APFC panels for power factor correction
LT panels for industrial distribution
Isolation and distribution transformers
Custom-engineered electrical solutions for specific plant conditions

Why factories trust us:
Most manufacturers buy stabilizers based on nameplate ratings. After 30+ years in this industry, we know that's a mistake.
We start with load analysis. We look at inrush current, harmonics, voltage swing patterns, and the actual operating environment — not just what's written in the equipment manual.
Every unit is tested under real load in our facility before dispatch. We've seen what happens when this step is skipped. We don't skip it.
Industries we've served for 30+ years:
CNC workshops | Manufacturing plants | Pharma & packaging | Textile & injection molding | Hospitals | Labs | Data centers | Export to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kenya, Tanzania
What three decades of manufacturing taught us:
The difference between equipment that works and equipment that keeps working isn't in the marketing brochure. It's in the transformer quality, the relay selection, the testing protocol, and the engineering decisions made before the unit is ever quoted.
When you work with us, you're not just buying a stabilizer. You're getting access to the technical team that's been solving voltage problems in Indian factories since before most dealers existed.
No middlemen. No excuses. Just decades of accountability.
